card.name: Words introducing drug or condition restrictions
card.fires_on: Partway through or just after words that set up a restriction or requirement, such as contraindicated, predisposed, required, needing, or known to, in drug-label warnings. It also fires on DVT in contraindication lists.

modes.label: Inside contraindication words
modes.description: Partway through words like Anticonvulsants, Contraindicated or predisposed in interaction and warning text.

modes.label: Words after a drug or condition
modes.description: A short word after a noun that links it to a need or effect, such as needing, to, or required.
modes.example: Avoid the use of MACRILEN with drugs known<< to>> affect pituitary GH secretion

modes.label: DVT in risk lists
modes.description: The abbreviation DVT in a list of conditions that rule out use.
